newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Monday set a one-week repo tender to add market liquidity of a maximum 7.0 billion crowns.
Minimum rate in the tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate, a central bank statement said.
The NBS added 1.0 billion crowns through a three-day repo tender on Friday, with average yield rising to 19.83 percent from 19.50 percent on Thursday.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 20 lacked 3.40 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 31.
